card.name: Linking words before a drug or name
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, of, with, or) and the title General, placed just before a drug name or a proper name. Also fires on a few number positions in dosing lines.

modes.label: Link word before drug name
modes.description: A word like to, with, or, or of directly before a drug name in labels.
modes.example: History of serious hypersensitivity reaction<< to>> mirikizumab-mrkz

modes.label: War history phrasing
modes.description: A title or linking word before a name or place in World War history text.
modes.example: brilliant leadership from<< General>> George Patton, and limited German resources combined

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: A gap or digit inside weight-band dosing text.
modes.example: 3 kg to less than<< >>35 kg: 6 mg/kg
